heading: A continuing inquiry into the rules of complex systems.
home_summary: Science of Rules brings together the NSF Understanding the Rules of Life collaboration and SNU Grand Quest. This shared space connects their research questions, publications, people, and activities as the inquiry develops.

previous.title: A unified science of regulation
previous.program: NSF Big Ideas · Understanding the Rules of Life
previous.description: Led by Hyejin Youn, this earlier project sought common principles of regulatory functions and networks across biological and social systems. It asked how regulatory structures emerge, why their costs grow, and how regulation supports complex systems.

current.title: Toward a Science of Rules
current.description: Grand Quest extends the inquiry toward the evolution of rules and the role of AI in institutional self-correction. Research across both collaborations informs the questions and publications collected here.

connection: A shared research space for work on regulation across complex systems, the evolution of rules, and the possibilities introduced by AI.
